## Introduction

To asses the impact of organic solvents on the activity of drug-metabolizing enzymes in Hep-G2-2E1, cells were co-incubated with chlorzoxazone and a solvent and the formation of 6-hydroxychlorzoxazone and its sulfate and glucuronic acid conjugates was assessed. 6-hydroxychlorzoxazone concentration was measured using external calibration while its sulfate and glucuronic acid conjugates were semi-quantitated using peak are. All values are expressed relative to a control without organic solvent.


## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DescTools)
```

## Calculate inhibition

### 6-Hydroxychlorzoxazone

#### Clean data

```{r}
czx <- read_csv("files/quant/260220_2e1_solvent_inhibition_6-hydroxychlorzoxazone_CalibrationDataPoint.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) 

head(czx)
```

```{r}
clean_data <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(Quantity = case_when(Quantity == "n.a." ~ NA,
                                .default = Quantity)) %>%
    mutate(Quantity = str_remove_all(Quantity, " units")) %>%
    mutate(Quantity = as.numeric(Quantity)) %>%
    filter(!str_detect(`Active Data Point`, "Blank")) %>%
    filter(!str_detect(`Active Data Point`, "cal_")) %>%
    select(`Active Data Point`, Quantity) %>%
    mutate(sample = str_remove_all(`Active Data Point`, "^[0-9]{1,}\\_{0,}perc\\_{0,}")) %>%
    # manually change buoh sample name
    mutate(sample = case_when(sample == "buoh_1_38_1_15399" ~ "buoh_2_38_1_15399",
                              sample == "buoh_1_39_1_15400" ~ "buoh_3_39_1_15400",
                              sample == "buoh_1_40_1_15401" ~ "buoh_4_40_1_15401",
                              .default = sample)) %>%
    # manually change acn sample name
    mutate(sample = case_when(sample == "acn_1_94_1_15501" ~ "acn_2_94_1_15501",
                              sample == "acn_1_95_1_15502" ~ "acn_3_95_1_15502",
                              sample == "acn_1_96_1_15503" ~ "acn_4_96_1_15503",
                              .default = sample))
}

czx_cleaned <- clean_data(czx) 
```

Visualize QC:

```{r}
viz_qc <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(str_detect(sample, "^QC")) %>%
    mutate(meas_order = as.factor(as.integer(str_extract(sample, "[0-9]{1,}$")))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(meas_order, Quantity)) +
      geom_point() +
      ylim(0,NA)
}

viz_qc(czx_cleaned)
```

No apparent trend.



```{r}
solvent_lookup = c("acetone" = "Acetone",
                   "acn" = "Acetonitrile",
                   "buoh" = "1-Butanol",
                   "ctrl" = "Control",
                   "dmf" = "N,N-Dimethyl-formamide",
                   "dmso" = "Dimethyl sulfoxide",
                   "etoh" = "Ethanol",
                   "ipa" = "2-Propanol",
                   "meoh" = "Methanol")

extract_metadata <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!str_detect(sample, "^QC")) %>%
    mutate(sample = str_extract(sample, "^[a-z]{1,}\\_[0-9]{1,}")) %>%
    mutate(conc = str_extract(`Active Data Point`, "^[0-9]{1,}")) %>%
    mutate(conc = case_when(conc == "1" ~ 1,
                          conc == "01" ~ 0.1,
                          .default = NA)) %>%
    mutate(solvent = str_extract(sample, "^[a-z]{1,}")) %>%
    mutate(solvent_pretty = str_replace_all(solvent, solvent_lookup))
}

czx_cleaned <- extract_metadata(czx_cleaned)

head(czx_cleaned)
```

#### Normalize to protein amount

```{r}
x1perc <- read_csv("files/bradford/bradford_solvent_1perc.csv") %>%
  mutate(conc = 1)

x0p1perc <- read_csv("files/bradford/bradford_solvent_01perc.csv") %>%
  mutate(conc = 0.1)

prot_content <- rbind(
  x1perc,
  x0p1perc
)

normalize_to_prot <- function(data, prot) {
  data %>%
    left_join(prot, by = c("sample", "conc")) %>%
    mutate(norm_quant = Quantity / protein) %>%
    arrange(conc, sample)
}

czx_cleaned <- normalize_to_prot(czx_cleaned, prot_content)
  

head(czx_cleaned)
```

#### Normalize to control

```{r}
normalize_to_ctrl <- function(data) {
  ctrl_1perc <- data %>%
    filter(solvent == "ctrl" & conc == 1) %>%
    group_by(conc) %>%
    summarise(quant_ctrl = mean(norm_quant))

  ctrl_0p1perc <- data %>%
    filter(solvent == "ctrl" & conc == 0.1) %>%
    group_by(conc) %>%
    summarise(quant_ctrl = mean(norm_quant))


  ctrl_quant <- rbind(
    ctrl_1perc,
    ctrl_0p1perc
  )

  data %>%
    left_join(ctrl_quant, by = "conc") %>%
    mutate(rel_quant = norm_quant / quant_ctrl * 100)

}

czx_cleaned <- normalize_to_ctrl(czx_cleaned)

head(czx_cleaned)
```

```{r}
czx_cleaned_mean <- czx_cleaned %>%

  summarise(rel_quant = mean(rel_quant)) %>%

czx_cleaned %>%

    ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm(alpha = 0.2, cex = 5, size = 2) +

    facet_wrap(~str_wrap(solvent_pretty, width = 15, whitespace_only = FALSE), ncol = 2) +
    theme_bw()
```
##### Table t-test

Calculate p values via one-sided, unpaired t-test.

```{r}
calc_p_val_helper <- function(data, ...) {
  g1 <- data$rel_quant
  g2 <- data$rel_quant_ctrl
  
  test_stat <- t.test(g1, g2, ...)
  
  test_stat$p.value
}

calc_p_val_helper <- function(data, ...) {
  xval <- data$rel_quant
  
  test_stat <- t.test(xval, mu = 100, ...)
  
  test_stat$p.value
}

calc_p_val <- function(data, ...) {
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(sample_no = str_extract(sample, "[0-9]{1,}$"))
    
  ctrl_0p1_all <- data %>%
    filter(conc == 0.1 & solvent == "ctrl") %>%
    transmute(conc,
              sample_no,
              norm_quant_ctrl = norm_quant,
              rel_quant_ctrl = rel_quant)
  
  ctrl_1_all <- data %>%
    filter(conc == 1 & solvent == "ctrl")%>%
    transmute(conc,
              sample_no,
              norm_quant_ctrl = norm_quant,
              rel_quant_ctrl = rel_quant)
  
  ctrl_all <- rbind(ctrl_0p1_all,
                    ctrl_1_all)
  
  
  data %>%
    left_join(ctrl_all, by = c("conc", "sample_no")) %>%
    group_by(conc, solvent, solvent_pretty) %>%
    nest() %>%
    mutate(p = unlist(map(data, calc_p_val_helper#, alternative = "less" # Change to two-sided because solvents have been reported to activate some p II enzymes
                          , ...))) %>%
    mutate(significant = case_when(p < 0.05 ~ "*",
                                   .default = "")) %>%
    unnest(data) %>%
    #left_join(ctrl_quant, by = "conc") %>%
    #mutate(rel_quant = norm_quant / quant_ctrl * 100) %>%
    group_by(solvent, conc, p, significant, solvent_pretty) %>%
    summarise(mean_rel_quant = mean(rel_quant),
              sd_rel_quant =sd(rel_quant)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(solvent != "ctrl") %>%
    mutate(p_print = as.character(format(round(p, 3), nsmall = 3))) %>%
    mutate(p_print = case_when(p_print == "0.000" ~ "< 0.001",
                               .default = p_print))
}

czx_cleaned_summarized <- calc_p_val(czx_cleaned)

czx_cleaned_summarized
```

##### Table Dunnett's test

```{r}
calc_p_val_dunn <- function(data) {
  data_cleaned_sample <- data %>%
    filter(solvent != "ctrl") %>%
    group_by(solvent, conc) %>%
    nest() %>%
    mutate(cvec = map(data, pull, rel_quant))
  
  data_cleaned_sample_list <- data_cleaned_sample$cvec
  
  names(data_cleaned_sample_list) <- paste0(data_cleaned_sample$solvent,
                                                "_",
                                                data_cleaned_sample$conc)
  
  data_cleaned_ctrl_list <- list(
    ctrl = czx_cleaned %>%
    filter(solvent == "ctrl") %>%
      pull(rel_quant)
  )
  
  data_cleaned_list <- c(data_cleaned_ctrl_list,
    data_cleaned_sample_list)
  
  DescTools::DunnettTest(data_cleaned_list)[["1"]] %>% 
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(names = names(data_cleaned_list)[-1]) %>%
    separate(names, c("solvent", "conc"), "_") %>%
    transmute(solvent = solvent,
           conc = as.numeric(conc),
           p_val_dunn = pval) %>%
    mutate(significant_dunn = case_when(p_val_dunn < 0.05 ~ "*",
                                   .default = ""))%>%
    mutate(p_print_dunn = as.character(format(round(p_val_dunn, 3), nsmall = 3))) %>%
    mutate(p_print_dunn = case_when(p_print_dunn == "0.000" ~ "< 0.001",
                               .default = p_print_dunn)) 
}

czx_cleaned_summarized <- calc_p_val_dunn(czx_cleaned) %>%
  right_join(czx_cleaned_summarized, by = c("solvent", "conc"))
```

##### Plot with t-test p value

```{r}
#| fig-width: 2.8
#| fig-height: 6
czx_cleaned %>%
  filter(solvent_pretty != "Control") %>%
  ggplot(aes(as.factor(conc), rel_quant)) +
    ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm(alpha = 0.2, cex = 5, size = 2) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "crossbar", linewidth = 0.4, width = 0.4, color = "black") +
    geom_text(data = mutate(czx_cleaned_summarized,
                     ypos = max(czx_cleaned$rel_quant) + 10),
              aes(as.factor(conc), ypos, label = p_print),
              color = "grey50",
              size = 3) +
    ylim(0, max(czx_cleaned$rel_quant) + 20) +
    xlab("Solvent concentration / %") +
    ylab("6-hydroxychlorzoxazone conentration in % relative to control") +
    facet_wrap(~str_wrap(solvent_pretty, width = 15, whitespace_only = FALSE), ncol = 2) +
    theme_bw()

ggsave("plots/czx.svg", width = 2.8, height = 6)
```
